description: This file defines the StartedTimer interface, which extends Timer and TaggedMetricInstrument. It specifies methods for stopping the timer, checking if it's running, starting new segments, registering callbacks on stop, and retrieving segments and stop handlers, representing a component for timing and metrics collection.

classes.name: StartedTimer
classes.description: An interface for a timer that is already started, allowing stopping, segmentation, and callback registration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the timer and all its segments, returning a StoppedTimer.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the timer is still running.

methods.name: startNewSegment
methods.description: Starts a new segment within the timer with a specific segment name.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Registers a callback handler to be invoked when the timer stops.

methods.name: getStartTimeStamp
methods.description: Returns the start timestamp of the timer in nanoseconds.

methods.name: getSegments
methods.description: Retrieves all segments of this timer.

methods.name: getOnStopHandlers
methods.description: Retrieves all on-stop handlers registered with this timer.
